description: Add Reportes tab to AdminClient with general report and group report with CSV export. Pure client-side aggregation from the already-passed initialSessions data. No new API calls needed.
steps: 1. In web/components/AdminClient.tsx: add 'reportes' to TabKey type: type TabKey = 'evaluaciones' | 'grupos' | 'usuarios' | 'reportes'.
2. Add a 'Reportes' tab button in the tabs row (after 'Usuarios').
3. Add state for the reports tab: selectedReportCohort (string for group report cohort filter), dateFrom/dateTo (optional string date filters for general report).

4. Implement GENERAL REPORT section: using useMemo on sessions array, compute: totalSessions, breakdownByMethod (count per methodId), breakdownByReviewStatus (count per reviewStatus), optionally breakdown by isValid. Display as stat cards or a simple table. Add optional date range filter (dateFrom, dateTo inputs that filter sessions by completedAt).

5. Implement GROUP REPORT section: a select dropdown to pick a cohort from the cohorts list. When a cohort is selected, filter sessions by cohortCode. Show: list of students (name, email, dominant code, method, date). Summary stats below the list: most common dominant code (mode), method used (or methods used), total count. Use useMemo for the filtered+aggregated data.

6. Implement 'Exportar CSV' button for the group report: a client-side function that takes the filtered sessions array and generates a CSV string (columns: Nombre, Correo, Código Dominante, Método, Fecha). Use a Blob + URL.createObjectURL + anchor click pattern to trigger the download. The filename should be 'reporte-{cohortCode}-{date}.csv'. All column headers in Spanish.
7. The tab content renders only when tab === 'reportes'.
8. Verify: tsc --noEmit, build passes. No new tests needed for pure UI components (the existing test suite covers the logic layers).
acceptance_criteria: AdminClient has a 'Reportes' tab that is visible and clickable
General report shows total sessions, breakdown by method (count per methodId), breakdown by review status
Group report has a cohort selector and shows the filtered sessions with dominant code, method, student name
Group report shows summary stats: most common dominant code, method breakdown
Exportar CSV button generates and downloads a CSV file with Spanish headers for the selected group
All existing tests pass: npm run test -- --run
tsc --noEmit and npm run build pass
findings: Implemented successfully. Added 'reportes' to TabKey type, Reportes tab button after Usuarios, selectedReportCohort state, two useMemo blocks (generalReportStats for total/byMethod/byStatus/top5Codes, groupReportData for filtered sessions and topCode), exportGroupCsv function using Blob+URL.createObjectURL pattern with Spanish CSV headers, and the full Reportes tab JSX with General Report section (stat card, method table with %, review status table, top 5 codes table) and Group Report section (cohort selector, sessions table with 6 columns, summary stats card, Exportar CSV button). All 152 tests pass, tsc --noEmit clean, lint clean, build passes.
